current_status.from: Expired unless extension adopted [VERIFY: no extension resolution or replacement ordinance located on Troup County website as of 2026-04-29]
current_status.to: Replaced. The 90-day moratorium (adopted 2025-09-16) was extended twice: 90 days on 2025-12-02 (to 2026-03-16), and a further 90 days on 2026-02-17 (to 2026-06-14), per the county's official public notice. Troup County's own agenda system shows a final zoning text amendment on 'Data Centers and Cryptocurrency or Data Mining Facilities' reached '3rd Reading - Vote Eligible' status at the May 5, 2026 Board meeting, with ordinance text providing to repeal conflicting prior ordinances and resolutions; secondary news coverage (LaGrange Daily News, via a forum repost) describes a unanimous vote around May 8, 2026 adopting the final ordinance and lifting the moratorium. The May 5, 2026 meeting minutes were not yet posted to independently confirm the exact vote date/tally, so some residual uncertainty remains on the precise adoption date.

evidence.title: Public Notice: Moratorium - Data Centers
evidence.supports: Establishes the full extension chain of the Troup County data-center moratorium: original 90 days from 2025-09-16, extended 90 days from 2025-12-02 (to 2026-03-16), and extended 90 days again from 2026-02-17 (to 2026-06-14).
evidence.quote: The Board of Commissioners adopted a ninety (90) day Moratorium on Data Centers on September 16th, 2025. A ninety (90) day extension was adopted on December 2nd, 2025, set to expire on March 16th, 2026. On February 17th, 2026, the Board of Commissioners adopted an additional ninety (90) day extension to the Mortarium which is set to expire on June 14th, 2026.
